purpose: Authorize one fixed-world static LiDAR and spline-label feasibility diagnostic before any formal dataset design or training.

approval.scope: Use only the already audited Cano seed-0 world_000; capture exactly 24 static role-stratified Isaac RTX LiDAR poses (8 tunnel interior, 8 junction transition, 8 terminal approach) with a frozen VLP16-like 16x720 50 m profile and deterministic 5 m spline-direction labels. No new worlds, formal dataset, split, trajectory, training, model selection, threshold calibration, M-TARE integration, or backend substitution.
approval.confirmation_reference: User message after the exact scope and stop policy were presented: 可以你开始做吧

source.license_or_allowed_use: Pinned third-party Cano output is used only for local read-only research diagnostics and is not redistributed because no license text was present at the audited commit.

sampling.selection_rule: Deterministic before sensor observation: two event-clear interior poses per each of four tunnel splines; center and 1 m on the lexicographically first branch at each of four degree-3 junctions; 1.5 m and 3.0 m inward from each of four degree-1 terminals.
sampling.sensor_contract: Isaac Sim 6.0.1 RTX LiDAR, idealized VLP16-like 16 elevation beams from -15 to +15 degrees in 2 degree steps, 720 azimuth columns at 0.5 degree resolution, 10 Hz, 0.3-50 m, one return, no angular/range noise; sensor z equals spline axis z plus Cano FTA plus 1.0 m.
sampling.label_contract: Intersect every exported Cano spline with a 5 m 3D sphere around the selected axis pose, deduplicate branch headings within 8 degrees, rotate headings into the sensor frame, and max-compose 720 circular Gaussian targets with fixed sigma 3 degrees. Expected branch counts are 2 interior, 3 junction, and 1 terminal.

evidence.machine_metrics: For every one of 24 samples preserve raw GMO arrays, 16x720 raster and valid mask, CPU ray reference, label, shape/finite checks, valid ratio, hit-mask IoU, and matched-range median/p95 absolute error.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Render all 24 individual range/point/label panels, one all-24 range-label sheet, one all-24 point-cloud sheet, and one complete-world pose map; no best-case selection.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop and preserve failure if the original mesh cannot be consumed, custom RTX configuration cannot be created, any pose/label contract fails, or any frozen metric threshold fails. Do not generate replacement worlds, repair the mesh, change thresholds, or switch sensor/backend.

estimated_cost.compute: One short headless RTX GPU capture in the existing Isaac Sim 6.0.1 image plus CPU Open3D ray reference and offline complete visualizations.
